description: Land Title Settlement Department - Attiligoda South, Four Gravets Galle D/S Division, Galle District - Cad. Map No. 810017 and others
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about parcel numbers, extents, owners, and property rights. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land ownership registration and title settlement, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
